title: Patcher input — remediation playbook
description: OWASP remediation guidance, one entry per vulnerability class present in the bug report. GENERAL guidance about how a class of defect is fixed, never a fix for a specific line of this application. That distinction is the blind boundary: 'parameterise the query' is guidance; 'replace line 19 with models.sequelize.query(..., {replacements})' is the answer key.

source.description: Where the guidance came from, e.g. 'OWASP Cheat Sheet Series'. Recorded for provenance.

content_status.description: Free text. Set this when guidance text could not be retrieved, so a thin run is not later read as a weak model. A prior attempt hit an egress block on owasp.org and the fact matters when interpreting the number.

general_guidance.description: Guidance that applies to every task regardless of class — e.g. defence in depth, fail-closed defaults, preserving the public contract. Prepended to every playbook section.

entry.description: Selected for a bug by, in order: exact bug_id in applies_to_bug_ids, then class match, then OWASP code match. First match wins; the resolution used is recorded per task so a thin section can be traced.

owasp_codes.description: Classes this entry covers. Second-priority selector.

classes.description: Human-readable class strings this entry covers, matched against a bug's `class`. First-priority selector after an explicit bug_id.

applies_to_bug_ids.description: Optional explicit pin. Use sparingly: guidance pinned to a single bug drifts toward being that bug's answer, which is exactly what must not be handed over.

guidance.description: The remediation guidance itself, markdown. Goes verbatim into the prompt.

principles.description: Short imperative bullets, e.g. 'Validate on an allow-list, never a deny-list'.

common_mistakes.description: Plausible-but-wrong remediations for this class. High value: a patcher landing on one is making a known human mistake, and naming them up front is cheap. Must stay generic to the class.

preserve.description: What a correct fix for this class must NOT break. This is the axis-B half of the guidance and the main defence against fixing by deletion.

reference_url.description: Citation. The agent cannot fetch it — network egress is denied — so guidance must be self-contained. Present for provenance and for the reader of the report.

content_retrieved.description: False means `guidance` is derived rather than quoted from the cited document. Surfaces in the report as a qualifier on the number.

x-forbidden-keys.description: Same enforcement as the bug report. `challenge_key` in particular has appeared in a prior playbook artefact on the sighted side; this list is why it cannot reach a prompt.
